        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table (tymove firmy)\nCREATE TABLE teams (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (year &gt;= 1 AND year &lt;= 3),\n    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (extends auth.users)\nCREATE TABLE profiles (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    school_email TEXT,\n    locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cs' CHECK (locale IN ('cs', 'en')),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails table (admin-imported from Excel)\nCREATE TABLE pre_registered_emails         "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile, optionally with team data included\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param includeTeam - Whether to fetch team data along with the profile. Defaults to true.\n * @returns The profile data with team (if includeTeam is true) or null otherwise\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient,\n  includeTeam: boolean = false,\n): Promise&lt;ProfileWithTeam | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Build select query conditionally based on includeTeam parameter\n  const selectQuery = includeTeam\n    ? &#96;\n      *,\n      team:teams(*)\n    &#96;\n    : \"*\";\n\n  // Query profiles - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profile, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(selectQuery)\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profile) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Transform the response to match ProfileWithTeam interface\n  // If team was fetched, extract it; otherwise set to null\n  const team = includeTeam ? ((profile as any).team || null) : null;\n\n  return {\n    ...profile,\n    team,\n  } as ProfileWithTeam;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp;         "contents": "-- Tappka Reservation System Migration\n-- Creates tables for rooms, reservations, recurring schedules, cowork participants, room issues, and schedule breaks\n\n-- ============================================\n-- EXTENSIONS\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraint (preventing overlapping reservations)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Reservation types\nCREATE TYPE reservation_type AS ENUM ('personal', 'training_session', 'houston_calling');\n\n-- Issue types for room problems\nCREATE TYPE issue_type AS ENUM ('locked', 'mess', 'technical', 'other');\nCREATE TYPE issue_status AS ENUM ('open', 'resolved');\n\n-- Schedule break types (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TYPE schedule_break_type AS ENUM ('days_of_joy', 'holiday', 'other');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms table\n-- Stores all reservable rooms with their rules\nCREATE TABLE rooms (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- 'd126', 'd132', etc. (used in URLs)\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'D126', 'Tichá místnost', etc.\n    description TEXT,                    -- Optional description\n    available_days INTEGER[],            -- NULL = all days, [3] = Wednesday only (0=Sun, 1=Mon, etc.)\n    can_have_ts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,  -- Can have Training Sessions?\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Recurring schedules table\n-- Stores recurring Training Session schedules set by coaches\nCREATE TABLE recurring_schedules (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "# Tappka Authentication System Design\n\n**Date:** 2026-01-25  \n**Status:** Approved  \n**Author:** Claude + User collaboration\n\n## Overview\n\nTappka is a student portal for Tiimiakatemia Prague (TAP) students. This design covers the authentication and verification system that allows students, coaches, and admins to access the platform.\n\n## User Roles\n\n| Role | Description | Team Required |\n|------|-------------|---------------|\n| Student | Regular TAP student | Yes |\n| Team Leader | Leads a team company (tymova firma) | Yes |\n| Coach | Program coach/mentor | No |\n| Admin | Full system access, user management | No |\n\n## Authentication Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐\n│   Landing    │     │  Register    │     │    Login     │\n│   Page (/)   │────▶│  /auth/      │────▶│   Success    │\n│              │     │  sign-up     │     │              │\n└──────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └──────┬───────┘\n                                                  │\n                                                  ▼\n                                          ┌──────────────┐\n                                          │  Is user     │\n                                          │  verified?   │\n                                          └──────┬───────┘\n                                                 │\n                              ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐\n                              │ NO               │                  │ YES\n                              ▼                  │                  ▼\n                     ┌──────────────┐            │         ┌──────────────┐\n                     │   /verify    │            │         │  /dashboard  │",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Tappka Authentication System Design",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**Date:** 2026-01-25  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**Status:** Approved  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Author:** Claude + User collaboration",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Overview",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "Tappka is a student portal for Tiimiakatemia Prague (TAP) students. This design covers the authentication and verification system that allows students, coaches, and admins to access the platform.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## User Roles",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "| Role | Description | Team Required |",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|-------------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "| Student | Regular TAP student | Yes |",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "| Team Leader | Leads a team company (tymova firma) | Yes |",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "| Coach | Program coach/mentor | No |",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "| Admin | Full system access, user management | No |",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "## Authentication Flow",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Landing    │     │  Register    │     │    Login     │",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "│   Page (/)   │────▶│  /auth/      │────▶│   Success    │",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "│              │     │  sign-up     │     │              │",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "└──────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └──────┬───────┘",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "                                                  │",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "                                                  ▼",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "                                          ┌──────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "                                          │  Is user     │",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "                                          │  verified?   │",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "                                          └──────┬───────┘",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "                                                 │",

          },
          {
            "text": "                              ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────┐",

          },
          {

          },

            "text": "                              ▼                  │                  ▼",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "                     │   /verify    │            │         │  /dashboard  │",
            "lineNumber": 39
          }
        ]

start_time),\n    \n    -- Prevent overlapping active reservations for the same room\n    CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (\n        room_id WITH =,\n        tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &amp;&amp;\n    ) WHERE (status = 'active')\n);\n\n-- Cowork participants table\n-- Stores users who joined open cowork reservations\nCREATE TABLE cowork_participants (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    reservation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES reservations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Each user can only join a reservation once\n    UNIQUE(reservation_id, user_id)\n);\n\n-- Room issues table\n-- Stores reported problems with rooms\nCREATE TABLE room_issues (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",
